digest.component_or_area: plan review criterion gates (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability)
propositions: Four agentic criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) generated zero findings across ~7,900 runs due to overly broad or ineffective triggers.
Deterministic pre-filter gates using audit-validated vocabulary regexes and file_impact conditions reduce false negatives while preserving LLM router applicability decisions on fired plans.
Not-fired criteria skip LLM routing entirely and are logged in coverage.routing.det_gated; fired criteria route unchanged through the existing ADR-0034 LLM router.

Conjunction semantics (asserted-capability text_all legs) and three distinct rule arms (text_all regexes, file_impact_globs patterns, file_impact_reason_re regex) ensure precise criterion activation without reinventing removal-detection signals.
